updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to access the group feed in Microsoft Viva Engage

User impact: Users may be unable to access the group feed with Microsoft Viva Engage.

Current status: We've identified a subset of service infrastructure that has dropped below our manageable service performance thresholds, preventing users from accessing the Microsoft Viva group feed with Microsoft Viva Engage. We're conducting service optimizations to the affected subset of service infrastructure to remediate the impact.

Scope of impact: This issue is preventing any user from accessing the group feed with Microsoft Viva Engage.

Start time: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 2:01 PM UTC

Root cause: A subset of service infrastructure that helps facilitate access to the Microsoft Viva Engage group feed has fallen below our manageable service performance thresholds, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to access the group feed in Microsoft Viva Engage

User impact: Users may have been unable to access the group feed with Microsoft Viva Engage.

Final status: Following our infrastructure optimizations, our internal telemetry verified that the impact had been remediated.

Scope of impact: This issue prevented any user from accessing the group feed with Microsoft Viva Engage.

Start time: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 2:01 PM UTC

End time: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 4:02 PM UTC

Root cause: A subset of service infrastructure that helps facilitate access to the Microsoft Viva Engage group feed dropped below our manageable service performance thresholds, resulting in impact.

Next steps: 
- We're further analyzing the subset of affected infrastructure to better understand the source for the lower-than-expected service performance, and to prevent similar issues in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
